title: Incorrupt
summary: INCORRUPT' INCORRUPT'ED, adjective [Latin incorruptus; in and corrumpo, corruptus; con and rumpo, to break.] Not corrupt; not marred, impaired or spoiled; not defiled or depraved; pure; sound; untaint

inlines.v: INCORRUPT' INCORRUPT'ED, adjective [Latin incorruptus; in and corrumpo, corruptus; con and rumpo, to break.] Not corrupt; not marred, impaired or spoiled; not defiled or depraved; pure; sound; untainted; applicable to persons, principles or substances.
